exercises.question: Which sentence describes a past situation rather than a completed change? [¿Cuál describe una situación pasada?]
options: Antes había menos tráfico. [There used to be less traffic.]
La ciudad creció mucho. [The city grew a lot.]
Construyeron una nueva avenida. [They built a new avenue.]

exercises.sentence: Antes __ menos tráfico, pero la ciudad ha crecido mucho. (haber) [There used to be less traffic, but the city has grown a lot.]
exercises.english: There used to be less traffic, but the city has grown a lot.
Over time, the area was transformed and new shops appeared.

sentences: Antes había menos tráfico. [There used to be less traffic.]
Construyeron una nueva avenida. [They built a new avenue.]
Desde entonces, las calles están más llenas. [Since then, the streets are busier.]

exercises.question: Which expression means «over time»? [¿Qué expresión significa «con el tiempo»?]
options: con el tiempo [over time]
de repente [suddenly]
al principio [at first]

exercises.sentence: Desde entonces, el __ ha aumentado. (traffic) [Since then, traffic has increased.]

exercises.english: The city has grown a lot since then.

exercises.sentence: Antes había menos tráfico, pero la ciudad ha crecido mucho.
options: There used to be less traffic, but the city has grown a lot.
There is less traffic because the city has stopped growing.
There will be less traffic after the city grows.

exercises.sentence: El barrio era más tranquilo antes de construir la nueva avenida.
options: The neighbourhood was quieter before the new avenue was built.
The neighbourhood is quieter because they will build the avenue.
The neighbourhood became noisier before the old avenue disappeared.

exercises.sentence: Desde entonces, el tráfico ha aumentado y las calles están más llenas.
exercises.english: Since then, traffic has increased and the streets are more crowded.

exercises.sentence: Con el tiempo, la zona se transformó y aparecieron nuevos comercios.
options: Over time, the area was transformed and new shops appeared.
The area has always had the same shops and traffic.
The area will be transformed after the shops disappear.
Ha crecido mucho y, desde entonces, hay más tráfico. [It has grown a lot and, since then, there is more traffic.]
Crecerá mucho y, desde entonces, habrá más tráfico. [It will grow a lot and, since then, there will be more traffic.]
Haya crecido mucho y, desde entonces, haya más tráfico. [It has (subjunctive) grown a lot and, since then, there be (subjunctive) more traffic.]
Sí, antes era más tranquilo, aunque ahora hay más servicios. [Yes, it used to be quieter, although now there are more services.]
Sí, antes es más tranquilo, aunque ahora había más servicios. [Yes, before it is quieter, although now there were more services.]
Sí, antes ha sido más tranquilo, aunque ahora será servicios. [Yes, it has been quieter before, although now it will be services.]

prompt.speaker: A
prompt.text: ¿Qué ocurrió después de construir la avenida?

options: El tráfico aumentó y la zona se transformó poco a poco. [Traffic increased and the area gradually changed.]
El tráfico aumentará y la zona se transformará poco a poco. [Traffic will increase and the area will gradually change.]
El tráfico aumente y la zona se transforme poco a poco. [Traffic increase (subjunctive) and the area change (subjunctive) gradually.]

template.prompt: Describe one important change in your city.
template.answer: Mi ciudad ha crecido mucho y, con el tiempo, han aparecido nuevos comercios porque creo que es importante para la comunidad.

template.prompt: Compare your neighbourhood now with how it was before.
template.answer: Antes era más tranquilo, aunque ahora hay más servicios y mejor transporte.
